# Setup
```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(Matrix)
library(readxl)

root.dir <- "/Users/pengja/PennNeurosurgery Dropbox/Jackie Peng/SilverbushLab/Projects/Jackie_post-mortem/"

suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(source(paste0(root.dir, "Code/", 'helper_functions.R'))))

n.vf <- 10000
output.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "ProcessedData/", "Sussman2024/", "tensor_decomposition/", "l1_top_", n.vf, "_vf/", "input/")
```



# Create a table/matrix for each sample
```{r}
seurat.obj <- readRDS(paste0(root.dir, "ExternalData/", 'Sussman_2024/', 'SeuratObjsFromLevel3ByPatientFinal/', 'all.samples.merged.not.downsampled.seurat.obj.w.annotations.RDS'))

seurat.obj$celltype.label <- seurat.obj$annotation.l1
celltype.labels <- sort(unique(seurat.obj$celltype.label))

# counts.df <- seurat.obj@meta.data %>% 
#   group_by(celltype.label, sample.id) %>% 
#   summarize(count = n())
sample.ids <- sort(unique(seurat.obj$sample.id))

min.cells.per.label <- 5 


# subset to variable genes
genes.keep <- rownames(seurat.obj)[rowSums(seurat.obj@assays$RNA$counts > 0) >= 50] # expressed in at least 50 cells
seurat.obj <- subset(seurat.obj, features = genes.keep)

pseudobulk <- AggregateExpression(seurat.obj, group.by=c("celltype.label", "sample.id"), return.seurat=T, normalization.method = "RC", scale.factor = 1e6)
data <- pseudobulk@assays$RNA@layers$data
data <- log2(data + 1)

gene.var <- apply(data, 1, var)
names(gene.var) <- rownames(pseudobulk)
gene.mean <- apply(data, 1, mean)
plot(gene.mean, gene.var)
variable.genes <- names(sort(gene.var, decreasing = TRUE))[1:n.vf]

variable.genes.df <- data.frame(variable.genes)
colnames(variable.genes.df) <- "variable.genes"
write.table(variable.genes.df, paste0(output.dir, "variable.genes.tsv"), sep="\t", quote=F, row.names=F, col.names=T)


# pseudobulk each sample x cell type pair
for (s.id in sample.ids) {
  print(s.id)
  seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = sample.id == s.id)
  seurat.obj.subset$celltype.label <- factor(seurat.obj.subset$celltype.label, levels = celltype.labels)
  
  # only use groups with more than min.cells.per.label
  label.counts <- table(seurat.obj.subset$celltype.label)
  labels.to.use <- names(label.counts[label.counts >= min.cells.per.label])
  seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj.subset, subset = celltype.label %in% labels.to.use)
  
  # sum counts and normalize to counts per million for each cell type x sample
  pseudobulk <- AggregateExpression(seurat.obj.subset, group.by="celltype.label", return.seurat=T, normalization.method = "RC", scale.factor = 1e6)
  data <- pseudobulk@assays$RNA@layers$data
  
  rownames(data) <- rownames(pseudobulk)
  colnames(data) <- colnames(pseudobulk)
  
  for (missing.celltype in setdiff(celltype.labels, colnames(data))) {
    new_col <- Matrix(rep(0, nrow(data)), sparse = TRUE)
    data <- cbind(data, new_col)
    colnames(data)[ncol(data)] <- missing.celltype
  }
  
  data <- data[, match(celltype.labels, colnames(data))]
  
  stopifnot(ncol(data) == length(celltype.labels))
  stopifnot(identical(colnames(data), celltype.labels))
  
  # variable genes only
  data <- data[variable.genes, ]
  data <- log2(data + 1)
  
  write.table(data, paste0(output.dir, s.id, ".tsv"), sep="\t", quote=F, row.names=T, col.names=T)
}

```




# Check current inputs and original inputs match
```{r}
# Load tools package for checksums
library(tools)

# Define directories
dir1 <- "/Users/pengja/PennNeurosurgery Dropbox/Jackie Peng/SilverbushLab/Projects/Jackie_post-mortem/ProcessedData/Sussman2024/tensor_decomposition/l1_top_10000_vf/input/"
dir2 <- "/Users/pengja/PennNeurosurgery Dropbox/Jackie Peng/SilverbushLab/Projects/Jackie_post-mortem/ProcessedData/Sussman2024/tensor_decomposition/l1_top_10000_vf/input_original/"

# 1. List files (relative paths so structure can be compared)
files1 <- list.files(dir1, recursive = TRUE, full.names = FALSE)
files2 <- list.files(dir2, recursive = TRUE, full.names = FALSE)

# Compare file names
if (setequal(files1, files2)) {
  cat("✅ Both directories contain the same files (by name).\n")
} else {
  cat("❌ File name differences found.\n")
  cat("In dir1 but not dir2:\n", setdiff(files1, files2), "\n")
  cat("In dir2 but not dir1:\n", setdiff(files2, files1), "\n")
}

# 2. Compare file contents (only for common files)
common_files <- intersect(files1, files2)

# Build full paths
paths1 <- file.path(dir1, common_files)
paths2 <- file.path(dir2, common_files)

# Compute checksums
hash1 <- md5sum(paths1)
hash2 <- md5sum(paths2)

# Check for mismatches
mismatches <- common_files[hash1 != hash2]

if (length(mismatches) == 0) {
  cat("✅ All common files are identical in content.\n")
} else {
  cat("❌ The following files differ in content:\n")
  print(mismatches)
}
```
